cim_eredeti: Community Banks Embrace Artificial Intelligence - RFD-TV
szoveg_eredeti:
MADISON, Wis. (RFD-TV) —More community banks are turning to artificial intelligence, raising questions about how they can accurately use the technology.

Generative AI consultant Ben Udell says bankers should approach AI-generated work the same way they would review work completed by another employee.

“People feel like they’re not going to be able to own their work with AI and if you use it correctly, you’re going to edit, you’re going to fact check, you’re going to review, you’re an experienced banker and it will pass the sniff test. When AI is off base, you know what? You go back into AI and say, you know what? That’s not accurate. Give me a better source or cite this source and just like you would do with a human being that’s working with you. It’s not any different. We just are freaked out because it has AI attached to it.”

State banking regulators found that approximately 62% of community banks are either using or testing AI technologies.
